picks.rationale_en: We read Rocket Lab as a hold on the medium-to-long horizon — composite score 40/100, 51% confidence. Above all, revenue growing 62% YoY. That said, realized volatility 40% (annualised). We'd step back if a daily close below the 50-day MA (~74.54).

reasons: EPS estimates revised up (2 up vs 1 down, 30d).

Sector earnings season relevant to Rocket Lab.
risks: Rich valuation (fwd P/E 1446) — sensitive to misses.
invalidation_conditions: A daily close below the 50-day MA (~74.54).
Negative earnings-estimate revisions or a guidance cut.
A shift in the broad market to a risk-off / correction state.
